title: Cedar Key Island Tours
specs: Tours visit at least three larger islands in the Cedar Key National Wildlife Refuge
Possible sightings of osprey, pelicans, ibis, herons, bald eagles, egrets, cormorants, terns, gulls, dolphins, sea turtles, rays, sharks, horseshoe crabs, blue crabs, and manatees
No stated age or weight limits

blurb: Guests take about 1.5 hour tours on a 26-foot catamaran with bench seating and cup holders. The tours visit at least three of the larger islands, many part of the Cedar Key National Wildlife Refuge. Wildlife sightings vary by season and include birds, dolphins, turtles, rays, sharks, and sometimes manatees.
extraNote: No dock at Atsena Otie, beach drop off with about 2 foot step down · Inside Boat Ramp, Cedar Key, FL 32625, USA
